remarks: This beautifully renovated colonial in the heart of Norwalk combines charm, modern updates, and a spacious layout, making it an exceptional place to call home. Featuring four bedrooms, two fully renovated bathrooms, a half bath, and a generous 0.23-acre lot, this property is perfect for both indoor comfort and outdoor enjoyment. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the home is move-in ready and offers an ideal balance of style and functionality. Conveniently located near I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and Norwalk's vibrant shops, restaurants, parks, and public schools, it provides easy access to everything the city has to offer. Ready for immediate occupancy, this home is perfect for anyone seeking a seamless transition to a comfortable and convenient lifestyle.
